_schema_notes: Maps project IDs (from the main guide's A1/B2/etc. scheme) to the recipe items (keyed to recipes.json) each one needs, plus a quantity where relevant. This is the join table a future guide generator uses: for a given project, look up its items here, then pull cost/power data from recipes.json to produce a total. Populate incrementally alongside recipes.json -- a project entry with an empty 'items' list just means nobody has linked it yet, not that it needs nothing.

items.qty: varies -- see G3 checkpoints for sizing guidance
